Instructions on how to compile/execute program(s)  
Open terminal 1  
On terminal 1: ssh into RPi  
		Install and Setup MQTT if not already done:  
			sudo apt install python3-pip  
			pip3 install paho-mqtt  
				Or  
				sudo apt-get \-y install python3-paho-mqtt  
			sudo apt install \-y mosquitto mosquitto-clients  
		sudo systemctl enable mosquitto.service  
		cd into folder containing project code  
Open terminal 2  
On terminal 2 (commands will differ per OS, these follow Windows 11 Terminal, used ChatGPT to help with this)  
		winget install \-e \--id EclipseFoundation.Mosquitto  
	$env:Path \+= ";C:\\Program Files\\mosquitto"  
On terminal 1: python3 poke\_the\_poker.py  
On terminal 2: mosquitto\_pub \-h test.mosquitto.org \-p 1883 \-t pokethepoker \-m "3"

// Code will run on terminal 1 by itself until one player is left unfolded, that player wins  
// To end game early.   
// 	On terminal 2: mosquitto\_pub \-h test.mosquitto.org \-p 1883 \-t pokethepoker \-m "end" 

// To see data visualization at game end  
On terminal 1: Copy MATRIX that is outputted at game end, ![][image1]  
On laptop or other controlling device:  
		Open plot\_poke.py  
		Find MATRIX, paste MATRIX from terminal 1 into plot\_poke.py  
		Save plot\_poke.py  
On terminal 2: python plot\_poke.py  
// If this is the first time plot\_poke.py is being run, it can take longer than expected to display graphs, this is normal  
// Next displays, even with new MATRIX values, will be quicker  
// To see next player’s graph, close current one
